profile.headline: Ruby on Rails Developer
profile.summary: I really enjoy creating coding solutions to business requirements. I have 7 years of full stack web development experience and 18 years of experience with IBM mainframe programing development. For several years I led a team of programmers, assigning work, mentoring junior programmers and ensuring the quality of the applications we produced.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created an AirBnB clone to market a rental property I own in Yucatan Mexico.
Created an application to store data about 19th century art exhibitions for use by art historians.
Created an application to allow commercial vehicle drivers to complete a pre-trip inspection of their vehicle and report any issues.
In the process of creating an application to display details of a Caribbean vacation tour which can take bookings and payments.
In the process of creating an application to extract data from the Department of Transportation websites, PDFs and APIs, store it in a database, and display various views to assist commercial vehicle insurance brokers make sale.
All the above applications use PostgreSQL and the latest versions of Ruby and Rails.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I was brought in as a Sr. Technical Consultant to design and develop Ruby code to add new features to the existing Ruby on Rails application systems.
I was responsible for analyzing the business requirement documents and writing the estimates for EventLink’s clients.
Utilized Terraform for the creation of AWS infrastructure for a new client.
DBeaver and SQL were used for writing queries to extract information from the existing PostgreSQL database.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
The business needed to offer Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and Single Sign On (SSO) to its customers. It was decided that Auth0 would be used to authenticate users and offer these features. Used Terraform to create an AWS Gateway and Lambda to migrate User authentication credentials to Auth0. Created a login script in Auth0 to encode and encrypt the authentication credentials entered by the User and to make a call to the Gateway. The Lambda decrypted and decoded the user credentials using the same password salt, number of stretches and encryption algorithm that was used to create the encrypted password on the User table, the stored password could be compared to the password that was entered in Auth0. 

The color of a car needed to be included in the insurance policy for rented vehicles. Changed the vehicle endpoint code in the API monolith to call a new Ruby service. The service made a call to a third party API (ChromeData) passing the VIN. The JSON response was then parsed to extract the vehicle color. The color data was stored in the vehicle table in the database. A change was also made to the Rails worker code that generated the insurance documents to include the color of the vehicle. 

The company had one toll data provider. To increase the toll coverage and to provide customers with a choice of toll data providers, a new provider needed to be integrated into the Rails API monolith. Analyzed the code for the existing toll processor and documented how the system worked. Coded a Rails worker to send vehicle information for dealerships with tolls enabled to the toll provider via an FTL file. Another Rails worker was written to make a call to the toll providers’ API to retrieve the toll data for vehicles registered with the toll provider. Used Rubocop and peer code review to maintain code standards. Used RSPEC to write unit tests. Made changes to the dealership database table, dealership endpoint in the API and the dealership UI to allow for the new provider.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
A Ruby on Rails medical device application that used computer vision and machine learning to measure the thicknesses of body tissue layers in patient ultrasound images. Based on its findings, recommendations for treatment were made. It also compared the results to any previous images to spot changes in the thickness of the tissue layers. 

Created documents for submission to the FDA to get authorization for use of the software as a medical device. 
Refactored code to reduce complexity, improve code efficiency and remove any weaknesses. 
Added unit tests if they were missing or insufficient. 

Analyzed a radiation dose calculator mobile app that was used in the treatment of liver cancer. Based on data entered in the UI by the doctor (such as weight, height, age, gender) the dose of radiation for the patient was calculated and displayed in the UI. The mobile app had 2 versions, one for iOS and one for Android. The iOS app was written in Swift and the Android app was written in Kotlin. 

Used Xcode and Android Studio to update applications. Made various updates to the code to fix bugs. Refactored code to reduce complexity, improve code efficiency and remove any weaknesses. Created FDA documents to get authorization for use of the software as a medical device.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Xcode · Android Studio · Java · Swift (Programming Language)

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Create full stack web applications using Ruby on Rails. These applications support the company's sales, logistics, operations, human resources, collections, and quality assurance departments. By working closely with members of each department requirements are gathered, solutions specified, and applications developed and tested. 

An example of the applications developed is the rapid order entry application. Previously sales representatives were taking orders from customers by writing them down and then entering the orders into the company's ERP system which can only reasonably be done on a laptop computer. This process was slow, and prone to errors. Orders were entered later in the day when the sales rep had collected orders from many customers. This creates a bottle neck in order processing and fulfillment that puts strain on the operations systems. To overcome these issues a web application was developed that can be accessed on a smart phone. The application allows the sales rep to enter an order while talking to the customer. The order process is much simpler than the one in the ERP system and so is much quicker. This saves the sales rep a lot of time which can be used to make more sales. Prompts in the app give the sales rep the information needed to upsell the order. Also the order is less likely to contain errors as it entered at the time it is taken. The order is processed immediately so removing the bottle neck in operations. The application has generated more orders, of higher values, with far fewer errors. The removal of the order bottle neck has reduced the periodic strain on the operations department considerably.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Project: Worked on a rapid order entry web application for the sales team. Previously the sales reps had to jot down orders on paper when talking to restaurant owners and chefs. After all the orders were taken, the sales rep would log in to the ERP system on their laptops and enter all the orders in quick succession.
Working with business personnel, analyzed system requirements and produced specifications for web applications to support human resources, logistics, warehouse operations, quality assurance and sales.
Designed and developed web application system (RUBY 2.2/ RAILS 5) that the sales reps could open in their mobile phone browser.
The web application would list the products most recently ordered by the customer, plus any seasonal items that the customer had ordered this time last year, as well as any products that were being promoted by the business.
The orders immediately entered the ERP system and the warehouse was notified.
As a result of this, app sales increased, customer satisfaction increased and warehouse and logistics efficiency increased.
